Lord Magnus' Magnificent Axe of Goshly Magnitude
Piece:  Weapon
Type:  Two-handed Axe
Class:  Fighter
Damage:  varies with item level

Lord Magnus' Magnificent Axe of Goshly Magnitude is a fighter two-handed axe.

It is unknown how many different varieties of this particular mythic item exist. Some of the Mythic items in this series may have the same name but different attributes.

This is a special 'thanks' to Lord Magnus for all of his hardwork on hdol.eu . Now go kill some monsters to show your gratitude!

Attributes:

The base item always carries:

  • + Agility
  • + Intellect
  • + Divine Damage
  • + Slashing Damage
  • + Mana Steal
  • + % Stun Resistance

Rolled copies can also pick up an extra ending. Those endings and their bonuses are listed on Mythic Suffixes.
